remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed release and direct users to verify the PyPI publisher and package provenance before installation.

content.value_statement: Unreviewed agent extensions can contain prompt injection, unsafe commands, secret exposure, or supply-chain risks. This skill guides local scanning and clear interpretation before trust.
actual_capabilities: Checks whether the local plugin-scanner command is available.
Guides local scans of skill, plugin, MCP server, and repository directories.
Produces Markdown or machine-readable scan results.
Runs skill structure linting and verification commands.
Summarizes severity, affected files, rule categories, and recommended actions.
Requires approval before installing the separate scanner package.
limitations: Requires the separate plugin-scanner CLI to perform scans.
Does not execute or dynamically test code from the target.
Cannot guarantee safety when a scan returns no findings.
Depends on the scanner version and its supported detection rules.

use_cases.title: Review a Skill Before Installation
use_cases.description: Scan a local skill directory and summarize security findings before adding it to an agent environment.

use_cases.title: Audit an MCP Integration
use_cases.description: Inspect an MCP server repository for prompt injection, command execution, credential exposure, and suspicious installation behavior.

use_cases.title: Validate a Marketplace Submission
use_cases.description: Run scan, lint, and verification checks before publishing an agent plugin or skill.

prompt_templates.title: Scan a Local Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Scan [PATH] as an agent skill and summarize the highest severity finding, affected files, and recommended action.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of one local skill

prompt_templates.title: Inspect an MCP Server
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit the MCP server at [PATH] for prompt injection, secret exposure, unsafe commands, and suspicious installation behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Publication Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Scan, lint, and verify [PATH], then report structural failures, security findings, and publication blockers.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Scan Evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the machine-readable scan of [PATH], group evidence by risk category, and prioritize remediation without claiming the target is safe.

output_examples.input: Scan the skill at ./skills/calendar-helper before installation.
output_examples.output: The scan found one high-severity prompt-injection rule in SKILL.md. Review the cited instruction and remove the override language before installation.

output: The scan found a medium-severity command-execution pattern in the startup script.
Review the cited command arguments and dependency source before use.

output_examples.input: Check ./plugins/reporter and tell me whether it is safe.
output_examples.output: No covered issue was detected by the current scan. This result is limited to supported rules and does not guarantee safety.

best_practices: Scan the narrowest local path that contains the requested target.
Review cited files and rules before accepting or dismissing each finding.
Describe clean results as no covered issue detected, not as proof of safety.
anti_patterns: Do not execute target code, install scripts, or lifecycle hooks during scanning.
Do not read environment files, credential stores, private keys, or unrelated secrets.
Do not install plugin-scanner or change Python environments without user approval.

faq.question: What can this skill scan?
faq.answer: It guides scans of agent skills, plugins, MCP servers, agent packages, and repositories available through a local path.

faq.question: Does scanning execute the target?
faq.answer: No. The workflow explicitly avoids running target code, install scripts, lifecycle hooks, and arbitrary target commands.

faq.question: Is Guard Cloud required?
faq.answer: No. The documented scanner runs locally and does not require Guard Cloud.

faq.question: Is plugin-scanner included with hol-guard?
faq.answer: No. The skill states that plugin-scanner is a separate Python distribution and command.

faq.question: Does a clean result prove the target is safe?
faq.answer: No. A clean result means the current scanner found no issue covered by its active rules.

faq.question: Can the skill install the scanner automatically?
faq.answer: It must ask for approval first. The documented installation uses pipx to isolate the CLI environment.
